analysis:
Examined both CLI-reference excerpts, the submodule metadata/pointer change, and the media-routing test metadata, patch and BASE source against the canonical index and supplied T-041 detail. The documentation range map confines substantive change to docs/provider/cli-reference.md:52, adding variable-frame-rate video support; the supplied later excerpts describe unchanged controls, not new cache, authorization, credential, fan-helper or logging behavior.
The added GLM5NextMediaRoutingTests.swift:256-309 test reads fixed local fixtures, checks their hashes, passes inline QuickTime/MP4 requests through request normalization and GLM5NextProcessor, and checks prepared grids/spans and scripted-engine submission. No new network fetch, production authorization bypass or plaintext persistence is visible. The test returns the existing synthetic preparedSubmission (BASE :131-135), so it does not establish actual video embedding submission, production memory accounting or inference correctness. Existing malformed-media and reservation assertions remain present; no supported regression was identified in the test change.
Material coverage limit: libs/mlx-swift-lm:1 advances the runtime dependency, but no dependency diff or implementation is supplied. Integration must inspect that revision's variable-frame-rate decoding/sampling changes and their interactions with MediaIngest and GLM preparation: bounded frame/decoded-byte allocation, cancellation, timestamp handling and plaintext temporary-file avoidance (A-001, TB-007, T-010, T-050). Any affected cache paths must preserve T-041 scope/authentication controls. The positive fixtures alone cannot establish these properties, and missing implementation is not evidence of a vulnerability. Deeper review remains necessary for this runtime change.
